content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows you to create websites directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means you can host your product store without the heavy fees associated with traditional e-commerce platforms. Unlike Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale, using GitHub Pages with NOWPayments significantly reduces your transaction fees to just 0.5%. This difference can add up quickly — for instance, on 100 sales per month of a $97 product, you retain an additional $921. This architecture not only empowers creators but also redefines ownership in the digital space.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind a GitHub Pages store includes several components that work together to deliver a seamless experience. First, GitHub Pages serves as the front end, where your products are showcased. When a purchase is made, backend logic is handled by Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which processes the order and interacts with NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The instant delivery of digital products occurs via file storage solutions like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This stack minimizes dependency on third-party platforms, giving you complete control over your products and customer data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are inaccessible or prohibitively expensive. Creators of ebooks, courses, templates, and various digital products benefit most from this system. By utilizing GitHub Pages and crypto payments, you can operate a fully functional online store without paying platform fees that eat into your profits. The infrastructure is built for those who want to take their digital sales into their own hands, ensuring they retain ownership and control over their creations.
GitHub Pages provides a zero-cost hosting solution for your digital storefront.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To deploy a GitHub Pages store, you need several key components. Start with GitHub Pages for hosting your site, which is free and user-friendly. Next, integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processing to handle orders and automate delivery. For payment processing, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept payments with minimal fees. Additionally, use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for storing and delivering your digital files. Each component is integral, and together they create a robust infrastructure that empowers you as a creator.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To set up your GitHub Pages store, begin by creating a GitHub account and a new repository for your website. Next, design your product pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage your backend logic for order processing. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions efficiently. Finally, store your digital products on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring they are ready for instant delivery upon payment confirmation. For those looking for a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a free hosting service like GitHub Pages combined with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to create a digital product store without incurring high platform fees, thus maximizing your earnings while retaining complete ownership of your content.
NOWPayments ensures you keep 99.5% of your earnings with low transaction fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell ebooks and templates without relying on traditional payment platforms, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides everything you need for a sovereign digital commerce stack, allowing you to bypass fees associated with platforms like Gumroad. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I create a GitHub Pages site for my products?

To create a GitHub Pages site, sign up for GitHub, create a new repository, and enable GitHub Pages in the settings. Upload your HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files to the repository. Your site will be live at a URL based on your username and repository name.
What is NOWPayments and how does it work?

NOWPayments is a cryptocurrency payment processor that allows you to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. It charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction and does not require KYC. It automates payment confirmations via webhooks, making it easy to integrate with your store.
Can I use Google Drive to deliver digital products?

Yes, Google Drive is an excellent solution for delivering digital products. You can store your files there and share them with customers through direct links upon payment confirmation. Ensure that the files are set to allow access for anyone with the link.
What advantages does this architecture offer over traditional platforms?

This architecture offers lower fees, complete ownership, and independence from third-party platforms. Unlike traditional platforms that charge high fees, this setup minimizes costs and allows you to retain all earnings from your sales.
Is there support available after deployment?

Yes, when you purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30 days of support to help you set up and troubleshoot any issues that may arise during the deployment of your store.
